events.title: Bioblitz at the Lakeshore Nature Preserve
events.subtitle: Join in the fun!
events.description:
What is a bioblitz? Think of it as a nature scavenger hunt where scientists, naturalists, students, and community members come together to identify as many species as possible (plants, animals, fungi, and other organisms) within a particular area over a set time period.

Why are we doing a bioblitz? We want to know what species live on the UW-Madison campus to help us guide ecological restoration and management of the Preserve.

Who can join? Curious beginners to experts!
events.location: Picnic Point entrance kiosk, University of Wisconsin-Madison, 2000 University Bay Drive, Madison WI 53705

events.title: Puppets from Around the World Workshop with Maya Malik
events.subtitle: Connect with a UW-Madison graduate student and learn something new in this drop-in artmaking experience.
events.description:
Join Maya Malik, Curriculum & Instruction PhD Student and Ed-GRS Fellow at University of Wisconsin - Madison to learn about the art of puppetry around the world and design your own puppet.

Shadow puppets and puppetry have a long history across the world. They have traditionally been used to explore deep emotions and pass on important cultural narratives.

Build a unique shadow puppet with pre-made templates, or build you own, and bring your story to life!
events.location: Chazen Museum of Art

events.title: UW Cinematheque - New Restorations and Special Presentations
events.subtitle: The Third Man | UK | 1949 | 35mm | 104 min. Director: Carol Reed
events.description:
Cast: Joseph Cotten, Alida Valli, Orson Welles
In the ruins of postwar Vienna, American writer Holly Martins (Cotten) arrives to visit old friend Harry Lime (Welles). However, Holly discovers that Lime is supposedly dead and under investigation for his role in the city’s lawless black market. Working from a screenplay by novelist Graham Greene, director Reed inventively directs this classic noir with a wealth of angled compositions and sinister shadows.
events.location: 4070 Vilas Hall
